items.title: Table C headline gap
items.action: Open a dedicated registry/evidence recovery batch; do not claim full Table C from this run.
items.boundary: Refreshing coverage recalculates the gap; it does not close missing evidence.

items.title: Registry proof level split
items.action: Keep showcase/smoke/deferred separated in reports and delivery language.
items.boundary: Smoke and deferred rows remain registered but cannot be called geometry proof.

items.title: Smoke and deferred proof boundary
items.action: Treat smoke/deferred rows as guard or backlog only until a readback report exists.
items.boundary: These rows must not raise cad_proof_count or geometry_verified claims.

items.title: Missing historical evidence reports
items.action: Recover real reports, rerun impacted CAD proof, or downgrade stale registry claims.
items.boundary: Do not create empty reports or derived snapshots to satisfy this debt.

items.title: RCAD smoke versus real capability scope
items.action: Use this run as representative CAD validation evidence; keep construction drawing claims separate.
items.boundary: A passing geometry gate does not prove arbitrary construction drawing accuracy.

items.title: Automatic drawing read boundary
items.action: Keep drawing-read output behind human confirmation before CAD execution.
items.boundary: Shell candidates and non-CAD benchmarks cannot directly write CAD.

items.title: Screenshot evidence boundary
items.action: Require screenshots to accompany, not replace, created-handle readback.
items.boundary: Screenshot pixels are visual aid only.

items.title: Local repair and delete scope boundary
items.action: Use target handles / bbox / neighbor protection before update, delete, or redraw.
items.boundary: No global cleanup, deletion, formal-layer edits, or save without explicit authorization.
